sloka: यो हि दत्त्वा द्विप श्रेष्ठम् कक्ष्यायाम् कुरुते मनः ।रज्जु स्नेहेन किम् तस्य त्यजतः कुन्जर उत्तमम् ॥२-३७-३॥
transliteration: yo hi dattvā dvipa śreṣṭham kakṣyāyām kurute manaḥ ।rajju snehena kim tasya tyajataḥ kunjara uttamam ॥2-37-3॥

translations.english: Having given away the best of elephants, will any one be interested in the rope tied to its girth? Why should one have any attachment for the rope after he has given up the elephant?
